title: Hallmark Radio Makes Spirits Bright This Holiday Season
summary: Listen on channel 105 now through December 26.
body_markdown:
Hallmark Radio is back for the 2026 holiday season, featuring timeless Christmas music and carols that celebrate the joy of the season, plus new songs from this year’s Hallmark original movies and series.


[Hallmark Radio Available through December 27 Coming Soon Coming Soon](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHallmarkRadio2025)


## Hallmark Radio


### How to Listen


Hallmark Radio is available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogHallmarkRadio2025) and satellite **channel 300** from **November 2 through December 27, 2026** .


### What You’ll Hear


Enjoy timeless Christmas favorites and carols, along with new music from this year’s Hallmark original movies and series. Hallmark Radio brings the warmth and wonder of the season to every celebration.


Want to share some holiday cheer? Leave a message on Hallmark’s[Joy Line](https://www.siriusxm.com/joyline) for a chance to be featured on the channel.


---


SiriusXM’s 2026 holiday lineup features **25 festive music channels** , including favorites from Jimmy Fallon, Trans-Siberian Orchestra, and Mannheim Steamroller. From traditional Christmas classics and country favorites to holiday rock, jazz, Hanukkah music, and seasonal soul, there’s something for everyone.


[Explore SiriusXM’s full 2026 holiday music lineup, including channel numbers, dates, and where to listen.](https://www.siriusxm.com/music/holidays)
